# NLTK :: Natural Language Toolkit

> NLTK is a leading Python library for natural language processing, offering comprehensive tools for text analysis, tokenization, tagging, and computational linguistics.

NLTK provides both educational resources and production-ready NLP capabilities, with extensive documentation, API references, and a community-driven development model. The project is maintained by a dedicated team and supported by the comprehensive 'Natural Language Processing with Python' textbook.

## Key Topics

- Natural Language Processing
- Python library
- Text processing
- Tokenization and tagging
- Named entity recognition
- API reference
- WordNet
- Computational linguistics
- Open source
- CoreNLP
- Text analysis
- NLP toolkit
- Module documentation
- Python 3

## Getting Started

- [NLTK :: Natural Language Toolkit](https://www.nltk.org): Homepage for NLTK, a Python library for natural language processing
- [NLTK :: Installing NLTK](https://www.nltk.org/install.html): Installation guide for NLTK on Windows, Mac, and Unix systems
- [NLTK :: Installing NLTK Data](https://www.nltk.org/data.html): Guide for installing NLTK corpora and data resources

## Documentation & Tutorials

- [NLTK Book](https://www.nltk.org/book): Comprehensive guide to NLP with Python and NLTK by Bird & Klein
- [NLTK Book (1st Edition)](https://www.nltk.org/book_1ed): First edition of Natural Language Processing with Python textbook
- [NLTK :: Example usage of NLTK modules](https://www.nltk.org/howto.html): How-to guides with code examples for NLTK modules and tools

## API Reference

- [NLTK :: nltk package](https://www.nltk.org/api/nltk.html): API reference documentation for NLTK package and submodules
- [NLTK :: Python Module Index](https://www.nltk.org/py-modindex.html): Index of Python modules in NLTK library for API reference

## Community & Development

- [NLTK :: NLTK Team](https://www.nltk.org/team.html): Information about NLTK project team and maintainers
- [NLTK :: Contributing to NLTK](https://www.nltk.org/contribute.html): Guidelines for contributing to NLTK development on GitHub

## Optional

- [NLTK :: Release Notes](https://www.nltk.org/news.html): Release notes and version history for NLTK versions
